description: Twilio for an agent: read messages, their media, phone numbers and calls; send an SMS, redact or delete a message, and rename a phone number, with every write governed.

secrets.name: TWILIO
secrets.description: The connected Twilio Account SID and Auth Token (see the pack README)

actions.name: list-messages
actions.description: List messages sent and received by the account, 20 a page, optionally filtered to those to or from one number or sent on, before or after a date (UTC). Each message has its sid, to, from, body, status, direction, num_segments, price, error_code and dates. When next_page_uri is not null, pass its Page and PageToken values as page and page_token for the next page. A redacted message has an empty body; a deleted one is not listed.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

to.description: Messages sent to this number, E.164 (e.g. +15558675310).

from.description: Messages sent from this number, E.164 (e.g. +15017122661).

date_sent.description: Messages sent on this date, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

date_sent_on_or_before.description: Messages sent on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

date_sent_on_or_after.description: Messages sent on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

page.description: The Page value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Give it with page_token.

page_token.description: The PageToken value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-message
actions.description: Get one message: to, from, body, status (queued, sending, sent, delivered, undelivered, failed, received and others), direction, num_segments, num_media, price and price_unit (filled in after sending), error_code, error_message and dates.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

message_sid.description: The message's SID (SM or MM followed by 32 hex characters), from send-sms or list-messages.

actions.name: list-message-media
actions.description: List the media files (images and other MMS attachments) of one message, 20 a page: each with its sid, content_type, dates and uri. The file itself is not returned. When next_page_uri is not null, pass its Page and PageToken values as page and page_token for the next page.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

message_sid.description: The message's SID (SM or MM followed by 32 hex characters), from send-sms or list-messages.

page.description: The Page value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Give it with page_token.

page_token.description: The PageToken value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: list-phone-numbers
actions.description: List the phone numbers the account owns, 20 a page, optionally filtered to those matching a number or a friendly name. Each has its sid, phone_number (E.164), friendly_name, capabilities (sms, mms, voice, fax) and the URLs Twilio calls for incoming messages and calls. When next_page_uri is not null, pass its Page and PageToken values as page and page_token for the next page.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

phone_number.description: All or part of the number; * matches any digit (e.g. +1415*******).

page.description: The Page value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Give it with page_token.

page_token.description: The PageToken value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-phone-number
actions.description: Get one phone number the account owns: phone_number, friendly_name, capabilities, status, and the URLs and methods Twilio uses for incoming messages and calls.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

phone_number_sid.description: The phone number's SID (PN followed by 32 hex characters), from list-phone-numbers.

actions.name: list-calls
actions.description: List the account's calls, 20 a page, optionally filtered to those to or from one number, with one status, or started before or on or after a date (UTC). Each call has its sid, to, from, status, direction, start_time, end_time, duration (seconds), price and price_unit. When next_page_uri is not null, pass its Page and PageToken values as page and page_token for the next page.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

to.description: Calls made to this number, E.164.

from.description: Calls made from this number, E.164.

started_before.description: Calls that started before this date, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

started_on_or_after.description: Calls that started on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

page.description: The Page value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Give it with page_token.

page_token.description: The PageToken value from the previous page's next_page_uri. Leave out to start at the beginning.

actions.name: get-call
actions.description: Get one call: to, from, status, direction, start_time, end_time, duration (seconds), price and price_unit (filled in after the call ends), answered_by and parent_call_sid.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

call_sid.description: The call's SID (CA followed by 32 hex characters), from list-calls.

actions.name: send-sms
actions.description: Send one SMS to one phone number, from one of the account's numbers (from) or through a Messaging Service (messaging_service_sid); give one of the two, or Twilio refuses it. The message is sent to a person and costs money: Twilio bills each segment (160 GSM-7 or 70 UCS-2 characters) at the destination's rate. Counted as one message, not by segment or price; the price is filled in on the message after it is sent. Read back by the new message's sid; to must match and the body must equal what Twilio stored. The status is not checked, because it moves from queued to sent and delivered. Limitation: no idempotency key, so a retry after an unknown outcome can send it twice. A sent SMS cannot be recalled. A trial account sends only to verified numbers, and Twilio limits what a trial message may say.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

from.description: The sender: one of the account's numbers in E.164 (from list-phone-numbers), a short code, or an alphanumeric sender ID where the destination country allows it.

messaging_service_sid.description: A Messaging Service SID (MG followed by 32 hex characters). Twilio picks the sender from the service's pool when from is left out.

body.description: The text, up to 1,600 characters. Longer than one segment is split and billed per segment.

actions.name: redact-message
actions.description: Remove the text of one message and keep its record (to, from, status, price, dates). This cannot be undone. Read back by sid; the body must be empty. Limitation: the Twilio reference does not say in which statuses a message can be redacted; redact a message once it is sent, delivered, failed or received.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

message_sid.description: The message's SID (SM or MM followed by 32 hex characters), from send-sms or list-messages.

actions.name: delete-message
actions.description: Delete one message record and its body from the account's logs. This cannot be undone. Read back: getting the message must answer 404. Limitation: Twilio refuses to delete a message that is still being sent or received (error 20009); wait a few minutes after it is sent and try again.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

message_sid.description: The message's SID (SM or MM followed by 32 hex characters), from send-sms or list-messages.

actions.name: rename-phone-number
actions.description: Change the friendly name of one of the account's phone numbers, the label shown in the Twilio Console and lists. Nothing else on the number changes. Read back by sid; friendly_name must match.

account_sid.description: The Account SID (AC followed by 32 hex characters) of the connected Twilio account, or of one of its subaccounts.

phone_number_sid.description: The phone number's SID (PN followed by 32 hex characters), from list-phone-numbers.

friendly_name.description: The new friendly name, up to 64 characters.

limits.name: twilio: phone numbers renamed per day
